# FLX-5001: intermediate magnitude outside the declared field capacity

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

A comparison formed from the declared value ranges and the maximum record count can produce an integer wider than the field it is evaluated in (KERNEL-SPEC §12). Narrow the declared range, lower fractionalBits, or lower records.max until the bound fits.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5001
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
